creator: kidfriendly.meals
title: Cold Lunch Ideas
summary: Make school mornings easier with these easy cold school lunch ideas! Find healthy, kid-friendly lunches that are simple to pack and require no reheating.
ingredients: 1/4 cup protein (black beans, shredded chicken, ground beef)
1/2 cup vegetables (cherry tomatoes, bell peppers, carrots, lettuce, etc.)
2 tablespoons guacamole, salsa, or sour cream
1 small apple or fruit of choice
steps: Pack all the components in separate compartments of bento-style lunch box.
